notes.sheets: Each sheet is one API call drawing a grid of frames; the previous sheet is passed back as a reference so the next one continues it. 8 frames per 3072x1536 sheet gives 768 px cells.
notes.hold: Seconds per frame, one entry per frame across all sheets (the first and last frames are the crossfade with the still sticker).
notes.motion: Gentle by design: nothing fast, nothing that travels. A sticker stays where the child put it; a blink, a yawn, a nibble, a peek read best at a few frames per second.
notes.normalize: Opt in (normalize: true) only for a base object that is the widest thing at the bottom in every pose — a lily pad, a perch. Feet, a curling body or spread wings make the measure jump.

Sitting on the lily pad exactly as in frame 1: same pose, same happy grin, looking slightly left, no fly anywhere.
